info.name: Voltix API - Full (Phases 2-10)
info.description: Run folder 1 first (only customerId needed). 2 needs Stripe test keys, 3 needs image.png + Cloudinary keys, 4 is manual, 5 (errors) after 1, 6 (cleanup) last. Base path {{baseUrl}}/api/v1; health and webhook are unprefixed. x-user-id is added automatically (temporary, until Phase 13).

exec: const payload = typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body);
pm.test('MacBook yes, Dell no', () => { const s = pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.slug); pm.expect(s).to.include('macbook-air-13-m3'); pm.expect(s).to.not.include('dell-xps-14'); });

pm.test('200 with specs and variants', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.specs).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(b.variants).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(b.variants[0].available).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('201, zero stock', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.priceMinor).to.eql(149900); pm.expect(b.available).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('201, on hand 10', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.false; pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(10); pm.expect(b.movement.type).to.eql('STOCK_IN'); });

pm.test('200 replay, same movement, stock unchanged', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.movement.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('movementId')); pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(10); });
pm.test('201, on hand 8', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.movement.deltaOnHand).to.eql(-2); pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(8); });
pm.test('201, on hand 7', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.movement.type).to.eql('ADJUSTMENT'); pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(7); });
pm.test('200, all at or below reorder level', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.every(i => i.available <= i.reorderLevel)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('3 movements newest first, ledger sums to 7', () => {

pm.test('200, 2 units, status OK', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.itemCount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.items[0].status).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(b.subtotalMinor).to.eql(2 * 149900); });

pm.test('200, totals consistent, no issues', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.hasIssues).to.be.false; pm.expect(b.subtotalMinor).to.eql(b.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.lineTotalMinor, 0)); });

pm.test('201 pending order, totals add up', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const o = pm.response.json().order; pm.expect(pm.response.json().replayed).to.be.false; pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('PENDING_PAYMENT'); pm.expect(o.totalMinor).to.eql(o.subtotalMinor + o.shippingMinor); pm.expect(o.expiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('200 replay, same order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.order.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });
pm.test('200, contains the pending order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(o => o.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });

pm.test('200, one active reservation of 1', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const i = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(i).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(i[0].status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(i[0].quantity).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('200, found by order number with customer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].customer.email).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('201 cancelled by customer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(b.cancelReason).to.eql('CUSTOMER_CANCELLED'); pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.null; });

sign(pm, { id: 'evt_postman_' + Date.now(), object: 'event', type: 'checkout.session.completed', api_version: '2024-01-01', created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), livemode: false, pending_webhooks: 1, data: { object: { id: 'cs_test_postman_unknown', object: 'checkout.session', payment_status: 'paid', payment_intent: 'pi_postman_unknown', amount_total: 100, currency: 'eur', metadata: {} } } });

sign(pm, { id: 'evt_postman_' + Date.now(), object: 'event', type: 'checkout.session.expired', api_version: '2024-01-01', created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), livemode: false, pending_webhooks: 1, data: { object: { id: pm.collectionVariables.get('sessionId'), object: 'checkout.session', status: 'expired', metadata: { orderId: pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId'), paymentId: pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId') } } } });

pm.test('200 CANCELLED / PAYMENT_EXPIRED', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(b.cancelReason).to.eql('PAYMENT_EXPIRED'); });

pm.test('201, first image primary', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.images).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(b.images[0].isPrimary).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.images[1].isPrimary).to.be.false; });

pm.test('200, removed gone, kept present, 2 images', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const ids = pm.response.json().images.map(i => i.id); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('imageId2')); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('imageId')); pm.expect(ids).to.have.lengthOf(2); });

item.name: M5. Refund in full with restock

exec: pm.test('202 full refund accepted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(202); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.stripeRefundId).to.match(/^re_/); pm.expect(b.full).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.amountMinor).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderTotal'))); });
